name: Business Entities: Ownership and Control
description: A pragmatic reading of the FIBO Business Entities (BE) domain for ownership and control analysis: people, legal entities and trusts; who owns what share of whom, who sits on which boards and holds which offices, who settles, manages and benefits from each trust; where entities are incorporated and registered; and the direct and ultimate parents entities report. Answers effective and ultimate beneficial ownership through layered and multi-path chains, control without ownership, trust look-through, collective ownership by a household, circular ownership, offshore layering, shared registered addresses, stale reported parents, and how two seemingly unrelated companies are connected. Adapted from FIBO (Financial Industry Business Ontology), Business Entities (BE) domain, https://github.com/edmcouncil/fibo, Copyright (c) 2013-2026 EDM Council, Inc. (also EDM Association dba EDM Council, Inc.) and Copyright (c) 2013-2025 Object Management Group, Inc., used under the MIT License (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT). A simplification for demonstration, not FIBO itself, and not endorsed by the EDM Council.

Person.label: Person
Person.description: A natural person who owns, directs, manages, settles or benefits from business entities and trusts. Owner, director, officer, trustor, trustee and beneficiary are roles a person plays, carried by relationships rather than separate labels, so one person's whole position across every entity and trust is a single node.

personId.description: Identifier of the person, unique within the dataset and stable across loads. e.g. `P-0039`.

name.description: Full name of the person as recorded in the source register. Not unique: two people can share a name, so match on personId. e.g. `Femke Fischer`.

nationality.description: Nationality (country of citizenship) as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; one nationality per person. e.g. `FR`.

isPoliticallyExposed.description: Whether the person is a politically exposed person (PEP) — someone entrusted with a prominent public function, or a close family member or associate of one — as determined by the user's own screening. A screening flag added for the demo, not a FIBO concept. e.g. `false`.

LegalEntity.label: LegalEntity
LegalEntity.description: A business entity with legal personality, formed and administered under commercial law to engage in business: a company, limited liability company, partnership, joint venture or not-for-profit corporation. FIBO's legal-form class hierarchy is carried as the legalForm property. Owners, directors, officers, parents and subsidiaries are all reached through relationships, so a corporate group is a connected tree of these nodes.

entityId.description: Identifier of the legal entity, unique within the dataset and stable across loads. Distinct from the LEI, which not every entity has. e.g. `E-0039`.

name.description: Registered legal name of the entity, including its legal-form suffix (Ltd, plc, GmbH, LLC, LP). e.g. `Verrano Capital Inc.`.

legalForm.description: Legal form of the entity, using FIBO business-entity class labels: publicly held company (shares traded publicly), privately held company (shares held by a small group), private limited company, limited liability company, joint stock company, general partnership, limited partnership, limited liability partnership, joint venture, not-for-profit corporation or cooperative society. e.g. `publicly held company`.

lei.description: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier: 18 alphanumeric characters and two check digits. Empty when the entity has no LEI; only LEI-registered entities report direct and ultimate parents. e.g. `XND600DZSSU9A4FSZZ59`.

registrationNumber.description: Identifier allocated by the registration authority of the jurisdiction of incorporation (company number, file number, HRB number); its format depends on that registry. e.g. `7293664`.

status.description: Registration status: active when the entity is legally registered and operating, inactive when it has been dissolved, struck off or otherwise ceased to operate. e.g. `active`.

incorporationDate.description: Date of incorporation or registration as stated in the filing documents. Only the calendar date carries meaning; the time is always midnight UTC. e.g. `1981-08-24T00:00:00Z`.

Trust.label: Trust
Trust.description: A fiduciary arrangement in which a trustor gives a trustee the right to hold title to and manage assets for the benefit of one or more beneficiaries. A trust can own shares in legal entities; who stands behind it is found through its trustor, trustee and beneficiary relationships rather than through ownership.

trustId.description: Identifier of the trust, unique within the dataset and stable across loads. e.g. `T-005`.

name.description: Name of the trust as stated in its trust agreement. e.g. `Smit Education Trust`.

trustType.description: Kind of trust, using FIBO trust class labels: revocable trust (the trustor can revoke or amend it), irrevocable trust (cannot be modified except in limited legal circumstances) or testamentary trust (an irrevocable trust created under a will). e.g. `irrevocable trust`.

establishedDate.description: Date the trust was established. Only the calendar date carries meaning; the time is always midnight UTC. e.g. `2009-07-03T00:00:00Z`.

Jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.description: A legal jurisdiction under whose law entities are incorporated and trusts are governed: a country, or a state or territory with its own company law (Delaware, Jersey, the Cayman Islands).

jurisdictionId.description: Code of the jurisdiction: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code where company law is set below the national level. e.g. `US-DE`.

name.description: Name of the jurisdiction in English. e.g. `Delaware, United States`.

isOffshoreCentre.description: Whether the user's compliance policy treats the jurisdiction as an offshore financial centre for layering analysis. A policy flag set by the user, not a legal classification and not a FIBO concept; lists differ between institutions. e.g. `false`.

Address.label: Address
Address.description: A postal address used as an entity's registered address or a person's residential address. One node per distinct address, so every entity and person at the same address meet at one node.

addressId.description: Identifier of the address, unique within the dataset; one per distinct postal address after standardisation. e.g. `A-0039`.

street.description: Street line of the address, including any building or suite name. e.g. `27 Market Place`.

postalCode.description: Postal code in the local format; empty where the country uses none. e.g. `SH12 7ZT`.

countryCode.description: Country of the address as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. e.g. `GB`.

personOwns.description: A person directly holds an ownership interest in a legal entity. A person may own interests in many entities and an entity may have many owners; the percentages of all an entity's owners sum to at most 100. Expected on every OWNS relationship: percentage and interestType.

percentage.description: Share of the owned entity's equity held directly by this owner, in percent (0–100): shares for a company, membership interest for an LLC, share of partnership capital for a partnership. Economic ownership, not voting rights. Effective (indirect) ownership is the product of percentages along a chain. e.g. `50.0`.

interestType.description: Kind of ownership interest, following FIBO's owner roles: shares (shareholder), membership interest (limited liability company member), general partner interest (manages the partnership and controls it whatever its percentage) or limited partner interest (no part in management). e.g. `shares`.

entityOwns.description: A legal entity directly holds an ownership interest in another legal entity — a parent in its subsidiary, a holding company in an operating company, a fund in a portfolio company. An entity may own many entities and be owned by many. Chains of these relationships form corporate groups and the layers between a person and an entity they ultimately own; a chain that returns to its start is circular ownership.

percentage.description: Share of the owned entity's equity held directly by this owner, in percent (0–100): shares for a company, membership interest for an LLC, share of partnership capital for a partnership. Economic ownership, not voting rights. Effective (indirect) ownership is the product of percentages along a chain. e.g. `100.0`.

interestType.description: Kind of ownership interest, following FIBO's owner roles: shares (shareholder), membership interest (limited liability company member), general partner interest (manages the partnership and controls it whatever its percentage) or limited partner interest (no part in management). e.g. `shares`.

trustOwns.description: A trust (through its trustees) holds an ownership interest in a legal entity. A trust may own interests in many entities. Ownership analysis stops at the trust: the people behind it are its trustors, trustees and beneficiaries. Expected on every OWNS relationship: percentage and interestType.

percentage.description: Share of the owned entity's equity held directly by this owner, in percent (0–100): shares for a company, membership interest for an LLC, share of partnership capital for a partnership. Economic ownership, not voting rights. Effective (indirect) ownership is the product of percentages along a chain. e.g. `100.0`.

interestType.description: Kind of ownership interest, following FIBO's owner roles: shares (shareholder), membership interest (limited liability company member), general partner interest (manages the partnership and controls it whatever its percentage) or limited partner interest (no part in management). e.g. `shares`.

directorOf.description: A person sits on the board of directors of a legal entity, with fiduciary responsibility for it. A person may hold many directorships and an entity may have many directors. Board seats confer control without any ownership.

role.description: Kind of board seat, using FIBO labels without 'board member': executive director (also employed by the entity) or non-executive director (no executive responsibilities). e.g. `executive director`.

appointedDate.description: Date the director was appointed. Only the calendar date carries meaning; the time is always midnight UTC. e.g. `2021-07-16T00:00:00Z`.

officerOf.description: A person holds an executive office in a legal entity with authority to act on its behalf. A person may hold several offices, in one entity or many, and an entity may have many officers; each office held is its own relationship.

title.description: Office held, using FIBO labels: chief executive officer, chief financial officer, company secretary, or managing member (the member who runs a limited liability company day to day). e.g. `chief financial officer`.

trustorOf.description: A person established the trust and placed assets under its trustees' management. Every trust has at least one trustor; a person may establish many trusts.

beneficiaryOf.description: A person is a beneficiary for whose benefit the trust holds its assets. A trust may have many beneficiaries and a person may benefit from many trusts.

personTrusteeOf.description: A person acts as trustee, holding and managing the trust's assets for its beneficiaries. A trust may have several trustees, individual or corporate; a person may be trustee of many trusts.

entityTrusteeOf.description: A legal entity — typically a professional trust company — acts as corporate trustee of the trust. A trust company may be trustee of many trusts, and a trust may have several trustees.

incorporatedIn.description: The legal entity is incorporated or registered under the law of the jurisdiction. Every legal entity has exactly one; a jurisdiction has many entities.

establishedIn.description: The trust is governed by the law of the jurisdiction. Every trust has exactly one governing law; a jurisdiction has many trusts.

registeredAt.description: The legal entity's registered address — officially recorded with the registration authority and where legal papers may be served. Every entity has exactly one; an address may be the registered address of many entities, as it is for a formation agent or a group headquarters.

residesAt.description: The person's residential address. A person has at most one recorded; many people may share an address, as members of one household do.

directlyConsolidatedBy.description: The entity reports this entity as its direct accounting consolidating parent — the closest entity that fully consolidates it — as in LEI Level 2 relationship records. A reported fact, not derived from ownership. An entity reports at most one; a parent may be reported by many.

ultimatelyConsolidatedBy.description: The entity reports this entity as its ultimate accounting consolidating parent — the most distant entity that fully consolidates it — as in LEI Level 2 relationship records. A reported fact that can go stale after an acquisition or disposal; ownership chains show the current position. An entity reports at most one; a parent may be reported by many.
